# 524Tracker

> Independent browser-based tools for organizing credit-card dates and user-entered values. 524Tracker is not affiliated with Chase or any issuer and does not provide financial advice or approval predictions.

## Maintained tools
- [Unofficial 5/24 Date Tracker](https://524tracker.com/): Counts user-entered account dates in a calendar-based 24-month reference window
- [Spend Tracker](https://524tracker.com/spend-tracker): Tracks a user-entered welcome-offer spending target locally
- [Card Value Calculator](https://524tracker.com/card-value-calculator): Subtracts a user-entered annual fee from user-entered benefit and rewards values

## Evidence and trust
- [Unofficial 5/24 Guide](https://524tracker.com/chase-524): Explains the community shorthand and its limits
- [Credit-Card Application Evidence Guide](https://524tracker.com/rules-guide): Separates issuer terms, government guidance, and community observations
- [Editorial & Sourcing Policy](https://524tracker.com/editorial-policy): Evidence labels, corrections, commercial independence, and review policy
- [Methodology](https://524tracker.com/methodology): Limits of the retired credit-pull reference dataset
- [About](https://524tracker.com/about): Public publisher identity and background
- [Privacy Policy](https://524tracker.com/privacy): Browser-local entries, hosting logs, optional services, and user-initiated exports
- [Accessibility Statement](https://524tracker.com/accessibility): Supported interactions, known limitations, and barrier reporting
- [Full AI Reference](https://524tracker.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed scope, evidence hierarchy, privacy limits, and canonical links

## Important limitations
- “5/24” is treated as a community-observed Chase application practice, not a published or guaranteed Chase policy.
- A reference count cannot determine eligibility, approval odds, welcome-offer eligibility, or credit-score impact.
- Verify current product and offer terms directly with the issuer.
- Tracker entries stay in browser localStorage by default and can be lost when browser data is cleared.
- Analytics, consent, and AdSense scripts are disabled by default and require explicit readiness flags.
